usage: cacheon [-h]
               {slots,compat,chain-compat,model-provision,set-weights,serve-weights,mint-push-credentials,mint-weight-gateway,push-weight-offer,follow-weights,chain-package,chain-publish,chain-eval-cost,chain-eval-cost-credit,chain-submit,chain-status,chain-reservation-status,chain-miner-report,chain-evaluation-lease,chain-validate,chain-snapshot,chain-snapshot-verify,chain-archive-schema3-hold,chain-release-hold,chain-reopen-qualification,chain-backfill-lineage,chain-register,scan,explain,verify}
               ...

Cacheon validator harness.

Commands by workflow:
  develop a kernel (miner) ... slots, scan, verify
  submit on-chain (miner) .... chain-register, chain-package,
                               chain-publish, chain-eval-cost,
                               chain-submit, chain-status
  referee + settlement ....... chain-validate, chain-snapshot,
                               chain-eval-cost-credit
  environment checks ......... compat, chain-compat

New to Cacheon? Start with docs/miner-guide/overview.md.

positional arguments:
  {slots,compat,chain-compat,model-provision,set-weights,serve-weights,mint-push-credentials,mint-weight-gateway,push-weight-offer,follow-weights,chain-package,chain-publish,chain-eval-cost,chain-eval-cost-credit,chain-submit,chain-status,chain-reservation-status,chain-miner-report,chain-evaluation-lease,chain-validate,chain-snapshot,chain-snapshot-verify,chain-archive-schema3-hold,chain-release-hold,chain-reopen-qualification,chain-backfill-lineage,chain-register,scan,explain,verify}
    slots               list the op-slot ABI
    compat              check our sglang integration points survived an upgrade
    chain-compat        check the installed bittensor SDK exposes the chain API we use
    model-provision     seal a clean exact model tree into a content-addressed external receipt
                        (transient cache paths are rejected)
    set-weights         control-plane reconcile of the transactional global reward projection
    serve-weights       serve the current weight offer (from a swappable object store) to
                        validators that currently hold validator_permit; run on cheap compute
                        separate from eval
    mint-push-credentials
                        create or rotate HMAC credentials for eval → serve-weights push
    mint-weight-gateway
                        create a dedicated serve-weights HTTP authority wallet (separate from
                        follower/chain signers) and optionally mint push credentials
    push-weight-offer   eval-only: build the current V1 or debt/composition weight offer and push
                        it to serve-weights; never submits on-chain weights
    follow-weights      fetch the shared current weights and publish them on-chain via the commit-
                        reveal reconciler (signer role; not the eval host)
    chain-package       tar.gz a bundle for hosting; prints the content hash to commit
    chain-publish       miner: package a bundle, publish it from the miner's S3-compatible bucket,
                        and verify anonymous validator fetch
    chain-eval-cost     miner: print the published eval-cost quote (v1 is a fixed TAO transfer)
    chain-eval-cost-credit
                        operator: grant one artificial eval-cost credit so a hotkey can submit
                        once without paying, or --list recorded credits
    chain-submit        miner: commit a bundle (hash + fetch URL) on-chain via timelock commit-
                        reveal
    chain-status        subnet snapshot: block, neurons, permits, revealed submissions
    chain-reservation-status
                        operator: read one durable reservation, queue position, typed outcome, and
                        retained evidence without taking the validator write lock
    chain-miner-report  every retained submission for one miner hotkey, each with its typed
                        outcome, stated cause, and next step
    chain-evaluation-lease
                        run one sealed, one-shot evaluation-lease store operation
    chain-validate      finalized reveal -> private fetch -> immutable worker publication
    chain-snapshot      validator: publish a private online SQLite/evidence/bundle recovery
                        snapshot to S3-compatible storage
    chain-snapshot-verify
                        validator: download and semantically reopen one private recovery snapshot
    chain-archive-schema3-hold
                        terminally archive one exact legacy schema-v3 reproduction hold; preserves
                        evidence and never signs, releases, or crowns
    chain-release-hold  operator: return one held or no-decision reservation to its queue with a
                        stated reason; never signs, settles, or crowns
    chain-reopen-qualification
                        operator: return one unsettled two-PASS reservation to the screen queue
                        for a fresh pair when retained evidence shows its credited half read the
                        baseline lane under the arena band; never signs, settles, or crowns
    chain-backfill-lineage
                        operator: rebuild the per-target lineage ledger from the newest CROWN per
                        target; idempotent, never signs, settles, or crowns
    chain-register      register this hotkey on a subnet (burned_register; needs the coldkey
                        password) + preflight
    scan                static policy scan of a bundle
    explain             say in plain language what happened to an evaluated bundle
    verify              op-level correctness vs reference

  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

                        historical state; repeatable
  --wallet WALLET
  --hotkey HOTKEY
  --wallet-path WALLET_PATH
                        optional Bittensor wallets root (passed to bt.Wallet path=); omit to use
                        the SDK default wallet directory
  --half-life-blocks HALF_LIFE_BLOCKS
                        emissions half-life in blocks (required)
  --discovery-lifetime-blocks DISCOVERY_LIFETIME_BLOCKS
                        discovery lifetime in blocks (required)
  --discovery-pool-ppm DISCOVERY_POOL_PPM
                        discovery pool share in ppm (required)
  --refresh-blocks REFRESH_BLOCKS
                        publication refresh cadence in blocks (required)
  --reconcile-only      confirm only from exact authoritative readback; never construct or invoke
                        a signer; a stale historical pending confirmation exits 3 with
                        refresh_due=True, while other submission/refresh cases fail
  --validator-hotkey VALIDATOR_HOTKEY
                        public validator hotkey required by --reconcile-only and usable for a
                        signer-free --release-hold
  --release-hold REASON
                        append an audited release of the current held publication; does not submit
  --burn-hotkey BURN_HOTKEY
                        all-uncrowned bootstrap only: project the full pool to this registered
                        hotkey (the subnet owner's burn registration) instead of failing closed;
                        refused the moment any crown or active reward claim exists
  --burn-to-subnet-owner
                        all-uncrowned bootstrap: resolve the subnet-owner burn sink from chain and
                        publish the full pool to it through the durable intent/pending/confirmed
                        journal with require_current_crown=False; refuses the moment any crown,
                        active claim, or activated composition exists in the intake DB, and
                        refuses a foreign in-flight journal head; does not publish shared weight
                        offers; usable with --dry-run or --watch
  --watch               keep the signer process reconciling and refreshing this policy; with
                        --burn-to-subnet-owner or --burn-hotkey the loop stops with a typed
                        refusal once settlement authority exists — restart without the burn flag
                        after the first CROWN
